age.Description: Age (Extended Data Table 1 of the article)

clinical_indication.Description: Clinical indication for implantation (Extended Data Table 1): Epilepsy, MDD (major depressive disorder) or OCD

n_ofc_electrodes_paper.Description: Number of OFC electrodes listed for this subject in Extended Data Table 1

history_of_mdd.Description: History of major depressive disorder (Extended Data Table 1)

n_electrodes_released.Description: Electrodes present in subject(n).electrode of the Dryad release

site.Description: Implanting site (UCSF n=5, WUSTL n=1 per README); per-subject site not given in the release

_mapping_note.Description: Extended Data Table 1 subject k is assumed to be release subject(k) (same order 1-6). The table's OFC-electrode counts (16,19,36,22,13,18) differ from the released electrode counts for some subjects, so the mapping is by order only, not verified.
